commands.name: help
commands.summary: Show the command catalog and shared project options.

commands.name: create-project
commands.summary: Run interactive product and architecture discovery, create a project spec, then propose the initial roadmap.

commands.name: analyze-codebase
commands.approval: explicit invocation authorizes source-read-only analysis and local checkpoint artifacts; no Linear mutations
commands.summary: Analyze a repository in bounded resumable stages and produce evidence-linked current-state findings.

commands.name: import-codebase
commands.approval: invocation authorizes local scan checkpoints; preview required before Linear project and milestone creation
commands.summary: Reconstruct a project and outcome-oriented historical milestones from codebase evidence, then create only the approved Linear artifacts.

commands.name: update-project
commands.summary: Revise an existing project spec after a product or architecture pivot.

commands.name: review-project
commands.summary: Review roadmap milestones for overlap, conflicts, ordering, and dependency gaps.

commands.name: onboard-project
commands.summary: Audit a legacy project and, after approval, normalize it for linear-spanks.

commands.name: audit-project
commands.summary: Produce a read-only compatibility diagnosis for a legacy project.

commands.name: normalize-project
commands.summary: Apply approved structural fixes from onboarding findings.

commands.name: checkpoint-project
commands.approval: before creating or replacing the authoritative Active Project Context document
commands.summary: Compact the active project frontier into a bounded, revision-linked context capsule without rewriting history.

commands.name: rollover-project
commands.approval: at each previewed release phase, with a final gate before resolving source work and completing the source project
commands.summary: Create a clean successor release project from a verified source project using a resumable, approval-gated rollover.

commands.name: run-project
commands.approval: invocation covers autonomous progress inside approved scope; preview gates project or milestone scope changes, exact integration, and stronger executor selection
commands.summary: Advance the durable project, milestone, and task orchestration loop by one fresh bounded event.

commands.name: set-human-verification-policy
commands.approval: one exact preview covering every affected active milestone, gate, checklist, and orchestration receipt
commands.summary: Set the project default or one milestone override for final human verification.

commands.name: status-human-verification
commands.summary: Report persisted and effective human-verification policy, gates, checklists, and drift without mutation.

commands.name: run-milestone
commands.approval: at each gated mutation; --autopilot persists guarded policy and stops at material gates
commands.summary: Resume one stage, or use --autopilot as the guarded milestone-loop alias.

commands.name: run-milestone-loop
commands.approval: invocation covers guarded automatic operations inside the bound milestone policy; material change, integration, model selection, merge, and push remain gated
commands.summary: Supervise fresh receipt-backed single events until a configured stop or event ceiling.

commands.name: clarify-milestone
commands.summary: Clarify intent, assumptions, constraints, and success criteria.

commands.name: design-milestone
commands.summary: Explore multiple architectural options before producing a milestone spec.

commands.name: create-tasks
commands.summary: Decompose an approved milestone into ordered, dependency-aware tasks.

commands.name: plan-tasks
commands.approval: covered by the approved planning stage; --next-wave preserves later tasks as Unplanned revision zero
commands.summary: Plan all tasks, or only the next live executable frontier with --next-wave.

commands.name: review-milestone
commands.approval: explicit invocation covers review persistence and safe repairs; material findings require fix-review approval
commands.summary: Review the stable contract and first wave, then use impact-closed incremental coverage.

commands.name: report-milestone-findings
commands.approval: invocation reopens one unambiguous owner; otherwise one exact managed repair-task preview is required
commands.summary: Submit one idempotent testing-session batch and require machine plus fresh human reverification.

commands.name: fix-review
commands.summary: Apply approved review fixes and require a fresh milestone review; incremental active repairs retain the implementing stage.

commands.name: verify-milestone
commands.approval: covered by the approved milestone execution
commands.summary: Verify every milestone success criterion using fresh evidence.

commands.name: confirm-milestone
commands.approval: explicit human confirmation of the current revision-bound checklist
commands.summary: Record final human confirmation, close the managed gate, and advance to human-verified.

commands.name: fail-milestone-verification
commands.summary: Record failed human verification, create one repair task, and return the milestone to implementation.

commands.name: wrap-milestone
commands.approval: before saving retrospective and learning artifacts
commands.summary: Persist the retrospective, approved learnings, indexes, and read-back evidence.

commands.name: design-task
commands.summary: Design a small standalone task without creating a milestone.

commands.name: create-bug-task
commands.summary: Create a bug task with reproduction, impact, and verification criteria.

commands.name: refine-task
commands.approval: before replacing the human draft description and moving it to Unplanned
commands.summary: Refine one Human draft issue into a stable task contract and move it to Unplanned after approval.

commands.name: plan-task
commands.approval: explicit invocation covers persisting the approved plan and moving the issue to Backlog
commands.summary: Create one authoritative implementation plan for an Unplanned task and move it to Backlog.

commands.name: organize-unplanned
commands.approval: before attaching tasks, creating a milestone, or creating complementary tasks
commands.summary: Recommend standalone, existing-milestone, or new-milestone placement for refined Unplanned tasks and apply only approved changes.

commands.name: run-task
commands.approval: covered by the approved task unless scope changes
commands.summary: Plan, implement, verify, hand off, and complete one unblocked task.

commands.name: replan-task
commands.approval: covered unless scope or downstream contracts change
commands.summary: Append a plan revision while preserving the original plan.

commands.name: review-task-scope
commands.summary: Assess whether a task should remain a task, split, or become a milestone.

commands.name: decompose-task
commands.summary: Recommend splitting or promoting an oversized issue.

commands.name: split-task
commands.summary: Split an approved oversized issue into smaller dependency-aware tasks.

commands.name: promote-task
commands.approval: before creating a milestone and tasks
commands.summary: Promote an oversized issue into a milestone with child tasks.

commands.name: verify-task
commands.summary: Collect fresh evidence before marking a task Done.

commands.name: backfill-completion
commands.summary: Draft and save a clearly labeled reconstructed completion handoff.

commands.name: implement-next
commands.approval: covered by the approved milestone execution
commands.summary: Select and run the next unblocked task using deterministic priority rules.

commands.name: implement-wave
commands.approval: explicit invocation covers preparing and executing one fixed wave
commands.summary: Execute one reviewed dependency-graph wave concurrently on isolated child branches and clean task worktrees.

commands.name: reconcile-wave
commands.approval: one approval after an exact ordered integration preview
commands.summary: Reconcile verified wave branches with merge commits, combined verification, durable receipts, and safe cleanup.

commands.name: status-milestone
commands.summary: Report runtime storage, policy binding, active wave, plan validity, review coverage, repair state, statuses, and dependencies.

commands.name: pause-milestone
commands.summary: Park a milestone while preserving its resumable state.

commands.name: resume-milestone
commands.summary: Synchronize and resume a paused milestone.

commands.name: sync-milestone
commands.summary: Detect external changes and reconcile only approved conflicts.

commands.name: archive-milestone
commands.summary: Gracefully archive a milestone and resolve affected tasks.

commands.name: trace-blockers
commands.summary: Report the transitive blocker chain and critical path.

commands.name: diff-milestone
commands.summary: Show milestone changes since a point in time or stage.

commands.name: handoff-milestone
commands.summary: Generate a runtime-aware context package for another agent or human.

commands.name: onboard-milestone
commands.summary: Normalize one legacy milestone.

commands.name: onboard-task
commands.summary: Normalize one legacy task.

commands.name: review-learnings
commands.summary: Summarize reusable learnings by tag and impacted area.

commands.name: apply-learnings
commands.summary: Return relevant, cited lessons before planning.

commands.name: organize-learnings
commands.summary: Draft cleanup for duplicate, stale, or low-signal learning entries.
